question: For schools administered by Ricci Ulrich, provide a comprehensive performance analysis including their SAT scores in all three sections, total SAT score, rankings compared to other schools, FRPM eligibility rate, test participation rate, and how their writing scores compare to their district average.

    sa.AvgScrRead AS Reading_Score,
    sa.AvgScrMath AS Math_Score,
    sa.AvgScrWrite AS Writing_Score,
    (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) AS Total_SAT_Score,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) DESC) AS Overall_Rank,

JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
